overview.value: Quando il mostruoso Gyumaoh fu sconfitto dal dio della guerra Nataku Taishi e imprigionato nel castello di Hoto, iniziò un'era di pace nella terra di Togenkyo. Per salvare l'umanità da un violento massacro, Bosatsu invia Son Goku, Genjo Sanzo, Sha Gojyo e Cho Hakkai ad ovest per impedire la resurrezione di Gyumaoh.
Sanzo ed i suoi compagni iniziano un nuovo viaggio, ma presto si trovano sotto attacco. Non da parte di demoni, ma da umani... (WIP)

Hakkai was attacked by a group of humans with yellow eyes while recuperating. He managed to somehow rejoin Sanzo and the others. However, although it was due to being attacked, their party had pointed their guns at humans. Feeling driven out, they left the city, and once again Hazel appeared before them.

Sanzo and his friends fought with Hazel and others, and released their daughter who was trapped in a youkai. However, in this case, the difference between the two ways of thinking becomes clear. That night, Hazel speaks to Sanzo. I'm asking you to help me to achieve a certain purpose ...?

A group of Sanzo who stopped by the town said that youkai could not enter due to the barrier by Master Soshin. Goku, Goku, and Hakkai, who are supposed to be youkai, have been put into the barrier, so although I felt the odor of the guru's power, I enjoyed the lively city for the first time in a long time. However, there was a hidden transaction behind it.

Goku is invited by the smell of fruits to enter the forest alone. There, a youkai had fallen over. What is the true identity of the youkai! ?? And in the second half, we will deliver that "Ura Sai"! !!

After leaving the forest, the party arrived at the next town. It was inhabited by many yellow-eyed humans that Hazel had previously revived. Sanzo and his friends have mixed feelings about the people who live in peace. What should I do when my life is lost to the life of a loved one?

Goku was dying in front of Sanzo. Sanzo, whose emotions are filled with murderous intentions toward the other party, runs away from the scene in order to find the person. The remaining Gojo and Hakkai will remove the gold sword with a bet of one or eight and release the power of Goku's Saiten Daisho.

Goku, Goku, and Hakkai, away from Sanzou. However, without a credit card, the three people, who have almost lost their sentences, fall down in the desert. It was the brothers and sisters who lived in a youkai-only village that helped them. They were in conflict with the city where humans lived over the oasis.

Gojo and Hakkai run a white dragon to a distant water place. Goku was left out, but the girl's older brother returned there as a miserable corpse. The youkai, whose anger exploded when they were killed by humans, board the oasis. Conflicting youkai and humans. Goku sways to the edge ...
Hazel continues to fight his way through the demon hordes. When he reaches another village where humans and monsters live together, it's up to Hazel and Gato to get the situation under control again.
Goku and the others drive the White Dragon to Sanzo. However, he is visited by an old nemesis. What is the purpose of this visit?

It was Goku, and Goku and Hakkai who rescued Sanzou, who was full of wounds, by the attack of the crow. However, the party is forced to struggle in the face of the power of Mutenkyobun, which changes everything to nothing. In addition, the crow points a new truth to Hazel.
As the memory revives, the youkai Vlahar, who had been suppressed inside, appears, and Hazel is hijacked. The future of the battle with the crows during the melee ...! ?? --Look at it!
